narration: In the existing method's first stage, the input image x passes through an isolated diffusion model to produce a reconstructed output x-prime.
In the second stage, separated without interaction, the absolute difference between x and x-prime forms residual x-rec, classified as real or generated.
In contrast, our proposed method first processes input x through the Feature-guided Multimodal Representation Enhancement module, creating pseudo sample x-pse.
Both original and pseudo samples are reconstructed through a shared diffusion model, extracting residual difference representations x-rec and x-pse-rec.
Finally, concatenated residuals are classified in an end-to-end training pipeline, providing direct feedback for better feature alignment.
